analyzed_vuln.description: When a class is associated with a common, the function adds the common permission count to class->num_perms and checks the combined count against CIL_PERMS_PER_CLASS (32). On overflow it logs an error and jumps to exit, but fails to set rc to SEPOL_ERR; rc still holds SEPOL_OK from the successful name resolutions. The invalid class/common association and oversized permission count therefore propagate as valid. Later, cil_classorder_to_policydb writes the class-specific permission at combined value 33 into perm_value_to_cil[class_index], whose allocation has only indices 0..32, causing the observed 8-byte heap-buffer-overflow at cil_binary.c:357.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: A parsed CIL policy must declare a class and a common whose individual permission counts are each valid (at most 32), associate them with classcommon, but have more than 32 permissions in total. The PoV's file class plus file common reaches/exceeds this combined limit. Resolution detects the excess but incorrectly returns success; policydb creation allocates PERMS_PER_CLASS+1 (33) pointer slots per class, copies the common permissions, then a class-specific permission receives value 33 or greater and is written out of bounds in cil_classorder_to_policydb.

args: Inspect selinux/libsepol/cil/src/cil_resolve_ast.c function cil_resolve_classcommon and the permission count checks in selinux/libsepol/cil/src/cil_build_ast.c functions cil_gen_class and cil_gen_common. Is explicitly setting rc = SEPOL_ERR before exiting each over-limit check the appropriate fix, and are there other CIL permission-count validation paths with the same stale-success-return pattern?

The supplied ASan report shows an 8-byte heap-buffer-overflow in selinux/libsepol/cil/src/cil_binary.c:357 after a classcommon association makes the combined class permission count exceed CIL_PERMS_PER_CLASS (32). In cil_resolve_classcommon, both name resolutions succeed and leave rc as SEPOL_OK; then class->num_perms is increased by common->num_perms, the over-limit branch logs and jumps to exit without changing rc, so policy creation proceeds. I also observed analogous checks after successful cil_gen_perm_nodes in cil_gen_class around line 445 and cil_gen_common around line 1019, where goto exit likewise appears to retain SEPOL_OK. I am considering fixing all three stale return values rather than only the reported classcommon path, while avoiding unrelated changes.
